result.brief: 提出 R²-WAM：利用世界动作模型自回归重放自身生成的轨迹，通过任务完成截断与动作-观测一致性过滤实现无数据持续学习，显著降低遗忘。
result.reason: Uses a video-generation-based world action model and regenerates rollouts for continual learning; contributes to action-conditioned world modeling and generative replay rather than representation learning.
